principle: Customer-facing Design Studio and Legal Operations products are compositions over existing DIO organs and proven product routes. Composition registration does not create an executor, execution proof, professional authority, public release authority, commercial validation, or automatic launch authority.

design_studio.label: DIO Design Studio
design_studio.customer_promise: Turn a bounded brief into coherent, audience-ready digital and document design while preserving source meaning, reviewability and release control.

legal_operations.label: DIO Legal Operations
legal_operations.customer_promise: Turn legal and regulatory operational requirements into evidence-bound readiness, document assembly, obligation tracking and professional-review packs without pretending DIO is a lawyer.

dio_site_studio.label: DIO Site Studio
dio_site_studio.buyer: SME, professional practice, school, research group, NGO/NPO or project team needing a credible public web presence
dio_site_studio.pain: Website work is fragmented across positioning, copy, visual direction, assets, forms and deployment, leaving the buyer to coordinate incompatible outputs.
dio_site_studio.outcome: A coherent review-ready website package with source-bound copy, design direction, responsive page assets and governed intake surfaces.

dio_launch_studio.label: DIO Launch Studio
dio_launch_studio.buyer: organisation launching a product, service, programme or campaign and needing one coherent market-facing package
dio_launch_studio.pain: Web, social, video, ads and email launch assets are often produced independently and drift in promise, proof, visual identity and CTA.
dio_launch_studio.outcome: One source-bound launch system spanning website, campaign creative, short-form media and governed response intake.

dio_report_pitch_studio.label: DIO Report & Pitch Studio
dio_report_pitch_studio.buyer: professional, research, NGO/NPO, education or SME team with valuable content that needs executive-quality presentation
dio_report_pitch_studio.pain: Strong source material loses impact when reports, proposals and decks are visually weak, inconsistent or rebuilt manually across formats.
dio_report_pitch_studio.outcome: A polished, source-faithful report or pitch package rendered consistently across document and presentation formats.

dio_popia_readiness.label: DIO POPIA Readiness
dio_popia_readiness.buyer: South African SME, professional practice, school, NGO/NPO or project team preparing privacy operations and documentation for professional review
dio_popia_readiness.pain: Privacy obligations, information flows, policies, notices, supplier evidence and remediation actions are scattered across documents and people.
dio_popia_readiness.outcome: An evidence-bound privacy readiness pack showing known requirements, source evidence, gaps, draft materials and review decisions without claiming legal compliance.

dio_corporate_readiness.label: DIO Corporate Readiness
dio_corporate_readiness.buyer: South African small business or organisation needing structured corporate record, prerequisite and deadline preparation
dio_corporate_readiness.pain: Corporate obligations, change events, supporting records, filing prerequisites and deadlines are easy to lose across inboxes, spreadsheets and ad hoc reminders.
dio_corporate_readiness.outcome: A governed corporate-readiness register and evidence pack prepared for an authorised filer, accountant, company secretarial professional or legal reviewer where needed.

dio_contract_desk.label: DIO Contract Desk
dio_contract_desk.buyer: SME, project, professional, procurement or operations team needing contract facts, obligations and evidence organised for human review
dio_contract_desk.pain: Contract dates, deliverables, dependencies, supporting evidence and review questions are buried in source documents and monitored manually.
dio_contract_desk.outcome: A source-bound contract review pack and obligation register that helps an authorised human understand and operate the agreement without DIO giving legal advice.

portfolio_truth.next_gate: Run typed composition validation, then prove each composition through one bounded controlled case before controlled-pilot launch consideration.
